test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: S, T, U, V, W and X are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). W sits second to the right of U. T sits second to the right of W. X sits to the immediate right of T. Who sits to the immediate right of X?
solution:
Given, S, T, U, V, W, and X are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order).

W sits second to the right of U.

T sits second to the right of W.

X sits to the immediate right of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2db489952499800e2eeee086376bfdcb0b867162f01cc1ff83e201adc3f2daf.png] 

So from above, U sits to the immediate right of X.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
